Name: Blue Market Unofficial Quality of Life Patch (Unsupported)
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000][b][color=#ff0000]Blue Market is not currently updated for SDV 1.6, so this mod will do nothing.[/color][/b][/color][/b]

This is a very small modification to the outdoor map from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13512]Blue Market[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/72952373]BPsys[/url]. It requires Blue Market v1.0.3 and all of its prerequisites to do anything at all, and will not function without it.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15862/15862-1749852994-1850066968.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Removes the trees in the immediate vicinity of the bus when arriving on the map, improving visibility. Several trees that were previously static are now able to be chopped down and will regrow.
[*]Modifies the tiles used around the Blacksmith, as the originals used tiles that only had a Summer variation. As a result--
[*]Removed the enforced Summer property on the map, it will now correctly reflect the current season of the game (the attached screenshot is from Fall).
[*]Removed the original warp back to the Bus Stop map, as this was automatic when walking into the bus's doorway. Now you press your action button to transition back to the Bus Stop.
[/list]
[color=#ff0000][color=#ff0000][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15862/15862-1749853006-1492972840.png[/img][/center][/color][/color]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley v1.5 or lower ([b]NOT [/b]compatible with 1.6)
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13512]Blue Market[/url]﻿ [/b]by[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/72952373]BPsys[/url] [/b](and all of its prerequisites)[b]﻿[/b]
[/list][u]
[/u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15862/15862-1749853014-249804921.png[/img][/center]
This mod contains two files, an updated content.json file, and an updated BMRute.tmx file. If you manually install your mods, simply drop my "BlueMarket" folder from the .zip file over the existing one in your Stardew mods folder. If you use a mod manager, [b][i]merge[/i][/b] this mod with the original Blue Market.
[u]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15862/15862-1749853024-653167939.png[/img][/center][/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/72952373]BPsys[/url]﻿, obviously! This is a very minor edit to a wonderful mod, and wouldn't exist without them. On that note, BPsys is currently inactive, but if they wish me to take this down due to planning to incorporate similar features into the main branch of the mod or because they feel this goes against their original intent, I will of course comply immediately.
